description: fetchngs writes an ampliseq samplesheet (sample, fastq_1, fastq_2, run) with --nf-core-pipeline ampliseq. Its run column is empty, so ampliseq treats every sample as one sequencing run and learns one DADA2 error model for all of them; data from several sequencing runs needs run filled per sequencing run: an inline handoff whose set templates it from a column that identifies the run, or your own samplesheet.
